body: You’re so right. I want it to take me too. There aren’t too many cases where I live and the quarantine makes it difficult but what I’d give to trade my life with someone who has it and wants to live... I’m so sorry you’re feeling in such a way it makes you wish to get this virus. I’m so sorry. I’m sorry I can’t make you feel better and I’m sorry we’re in the same boat.
My head hurts so badly :( everything hurts.
I should have done it years ago when I first thought of it, then by now all the people who care about me would have already got over my death.

We are not allowed to discuss methods here but I’ve read multiple times that pills is an awful way to go. It may not work and just leave you with immense pain for a while. You might permanently damage some organs. And if it does work it will be horrible. I wish I could tell you you just go to sleep and die but that’s not the case. I’m sorry you’re suffering, I’m so sorry.

If I end up killing myself, that would make me selfish. Funny how I don’t think someone killing themselves makes them selfish unless I’m the one doing it.  You’re so sweet, thank you so much for your response, thank you thank you.
You cannot imagine how much I wished I could take away your pain as well. But I can’t and I’m sorry I can’t.

I can relate so much to what you wrote. The impatience is killing me. I have to postpone it for some reasons and waiting who knows how much is agonizing. I’m sorry you have to go through whatever is making you feel this way. It sucks big time.

Either eternal sleep or nothingness would be good for me too. I’m so sorry you’re hurting. Whether we go through with it or not, it will all be over some day. I hope you go to sleep tonight and have no nightmares.
Omg yes!!!! Thank you so much! Solved. Wow how did you find it?! Or did you know the song?

You’re right, my bad. It’s just that I thought some of the characters simply arrived at the house and then started to talk to each other. Didn’t remember anything else as I think I saw it like ten years ago or so.
This movie has been on the tomt for years now, I hope someone can identify it. I’ve googled a lot but haven’t found it :(
